newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Search goes on for 11 Brazil fishermen; hopes dim.
newsitem.headline: Search goes on for 11 Brazil fishermen; hopes dim.

text.p: Brazil's navy and air force continued searching on Thursday for 11 fishermen missing and feared dead off the southern coast, port authorities said.
"The search is continuing," port Cmdr. Francisco Hippolito at Itajai in Santa Catarina state told Reuters.

Two fishing boats missing since the weekend were found -- one destroyed and the other capsized -- in the Atlantic some 60 miles (100 km) east of Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul states, Hippolito said.
"One boat is being hauled back to shore and all we found of the other was wreckage," he said. "What we're looking for at this point is the crew, but we haven't found any bodies or survivors."

Police Commissioner Elton Shechterhuff said late on Wednesday that the fishing vessels left Porto Belo port in Santa Catarina on Saturday and may have been caught at sea by a fierce storm that struck late that night.
"They're still trying to find them, but hope is running out that any survivors will be found," he said.

Authorities were notified on Monday that the two boats had failed to return and search teams were dispatched on Tuesday, Hippolito said. On Thursday a navy ship and two air force planes continued to comb the area but it was unclear how much longer the search would go on, he added.
